component.name: Anyscale
component.summary: Connect to several tailnets at once

description.p: Anyscale is a fork of Anyscale that talks to anyscale instead of tailscaled, so one machine can stay connected to several Tailscale and Headscale tailnets at the same time.
It needs the anyscale daemon, anyscaled, to be installed and running. Adding, removing and enabling tailnets and choosing an exit node ask for administrator access through polkit.

ul.li: Fork of Anyscale v0.21.0 on top of anyscale v0.1.20.
Sidebar that lists every tailnet with its own connect switch.
Add tailnets on Tailscale or any Headscale server from the GUI.
Exit node selection goes through the anyscale daemon.
